findings.statement: A two-edge peak-response approximation improves aggregate physical voltage error, but the original gain is concentrated in one contact condition.
findings.applicability: Whole pulse widths across six sensor/contact conditions; ten pulses within a file are repeated apparatus observations.
findings.limitations: Only contact 110 kHz improves against constant gain; five other conditions worsen. Six files at one width are not six independent sensor-transfer experiments.
falsification: Report normalized file-weighted error together with physical volts and all sixconditions.
Recompute pre-trigger subtraction and post-trigger peak without leaking the full response into predictors.
Test claimed resonance against native spectra using the selected-cycle comparison, not the earlier cycle 002 summary.
findings.prior_art: Damped oscillators and constant-Q constraints are established; no new resonance physics is certified. This review uses retained prior-art records only; it performs no new literature priority adjudication.
